subject: general
question: Which of the following is a folk dance performed by the 'tea tribes' of Assam?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __Jhumur.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jhumur dance is a traditional dance of tea tribe communities of Assam.
 
• The dance is usually performed during the autumn season in Assam.
 
• This dance is also found in few parts of West Bengal.
 
• This dance is performed by young girls mostly in an open areas like fields or under trees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alkap **is a Bengali folk dance popular in the districts of Murshidabad, Malda and Birbhum in West Bengal and Chapai Nawabganj, Randajshahi in Bangladesh. 
 
• **Domkach **is a folk dance of the Indian states of Bihar and Jharkhand.
 
 
• In Bihar, Domkach dance is performed in Mithila and Bhojpur regions.
